reviews.title: Image generator update is a big step back - please bring back the old version!
reviews.text:
Hi there,

I wanted to share feedback about the recent changes to the image generator. The old version was one of my favorite features of the app, and I used it all the time because it worked so reliably.

Now I’ve been really frustrated with how it works — I preferred the old version much more because it understood my prompts better and produced results that matched exactly what I had in mind.

For example:

• When I used to request “More moments” after generating an image, the older version would create completely new scenes, actions, and poses while keeping the characters and art style perfectly consistent. Now, it either repeats the same poses over and over, keeps the exact same background, or doesn’t create anything new at all.

• Before, characters always stayed exactly the same — same face, same proportions, and consistent size relative to each other every time. Now, they randomly change size: sometimes one is too big, the other too small, and their features shift so they don’t even look like the same people from one image to the next.

• In the older version, when I asked for something specific — different actions, expressions, or settings — it would actually do it. The new version rarely delivers what I request.

• It also used to generate quickly and give me options to choose from; now it feels slower and far less flexible.

reviews.title: Used to be great — now absolutely useless trash
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for ages and back then it was actually good. It gave proper detailed answers, clear explanations, actual theories and depth — exactly what you want from an AI assistant. It was reliable, straightforward, and worth having on my phone.

But whatever they’ve changed recently has ruined it completely. It feels like they’ve stripped out everything that worked and replaced it with something useless. Now every answer is vague, short, half‑baked, or just totally misses the point. It never gives you the detail or the proper breakdowns it used to — you just get lazy, generic rubbish every time. The new logo looks terrible too, just to add insult to injury.

It’s gone from being one of the better AI assistants out there to easily the worst one you can get right now. I don’t know what they were thinking with these changes, but they’ve absolutely killed what made it good. Don’t bother downloading it now — it’s a waste of time.
